bio: Christopher Murphy Rabb (born February 21, 1970) is an American politician who is the U.S. representative-elect for Pennsylvania's 3rd congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party and the Democratic Socialists of America, he has represented the 200th district in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives since 2017.
